entities.name: Naya
entities.description: One of five Shards of Alara, a green-aligned tropical jungle dominated by gargantuans; Ajani's birthplace.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane whose five shards reconnect after the Conflux.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker born on Naya, source of inspiration to many Leonin prides.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: An enormous five-headed hydra who sleeps in the Valley of the Ancient and awoke after the Conflux.

entities.name: Cylian elves
entities.description: Nomadic canopy-dwelling elves of Naya who worship gargantuans and are led by Mayael the Anima.

entities.name: Nacatl
entities.description: Leonin once rulers of Naya, split into Cloud and Wild Nacatl after their empire fell.

entities.name: Empire of the Clouds
entities.description: A former Nacatl empire destroyed by internal strife.

entities.name: Claws of Marisi
entities.description: A revolutionary Nacatl group that waged guerrilla war and broke the Coil.

entities.name: Pride of Judges
entities.description: An elite Nacatl group enforcing the Coil.

entities.name: Marisi
entities.description: Leader who started the uprising at Antali dividing the Nacatl.

entities.name: the Coil
entities.description: The Nacatl system of laws once recorded on a massive stone wall.

entities.name: Qasal
entities.description: Last known stronghold of the Cloud Nacatl, ruled by Timus the Orange.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The event that flooded Naya with all five colors and reconnected the shards.

entities.name: Second Stirring
entities.description: Progenitus's partial awakening fifteen years before the Conflux.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in which Alara was targeted by Elesh Norn's Machine Legion.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Phyrexian leader whose Machine Legion targeted Alara.

entities.name: Whitecover
entities.description: A thick fog over Naya's jungle.

events.summary: Internal strife and the Claws of Marisi's guerrilla war destroy the Nacatl Empire of the Clouds.
events.quote: But internal strife destroyed the empire.

events.summary: Marisi's revolutionaries defeat the Pride of Judges and the Coil is broken.
events.quote: In the end, Marisi's revolutionaries triumphed and the Coil was broken.

events.summary: Progenitus begins to awaken in the Second Stirring.
events.quote: Fifteen years before the Conflux , Progenitus began to awaken, tearing the vegetation from its roots and ripping off huge sections of nearby mountains in an event later known as the Second Stirring.

events.summary: At the Conflux black and blue mana flood Naya, and Progenitus awakens.
events.quote: Naya is now flooded with all five colors and Progenitus has awoken, roving the lands for inscrutable purposes.

events.summary: Naya becomes part of New Alara as the shards connect.
events.quote: Naya's borders continued to run into the borders of Jund and Bant until it had completely connected to the other five shards, becoming part of New Alara.

events.summary: Elesh Norn's Machine Legion strikes Alara in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Alara as was targeted by Elesh Norn 's Machine Legion as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion with a simultaneous strike on Bant, Esper, and Jund.

relations.note: Elves worship gargantuans as signs of Progenitus.
relations.quote: The elves worship the gargantuans of the plane, believing that the behemoths' actions are signs from Progenitus
Led by Mayael the Anima, the elves worship the gargantuans of the plane.
Soon there was open warfare in the streets as the Claws of Marisi and the Pride of Judges fought for dominance.
